item.title: 🟠 Microsoft SharePoint Flaw CVE-2026-65660 Now Exploited in Attacks
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

CISA added CVE-2026-65660 to its KEV catalog, giving federal agencies a patching deadline of September 28.

The post Microsoft SharePoint Flaw CVE-2026-65660 Now Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.



Source: SecurityWeek  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 3h

item.title: 🔴 Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
item.description:
Why this matters: Remote-code-execution risk — assess exposure and patch or mitigate quickly.
Two new unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow remote code execution are being actively exploited in the wild, security firm watchTowr said on September 26. item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Elementor CSRF Flaw Lets Attackers Take Over Sites After Admin Clicks Crafted Link
item.description:
Why this matters: Compliance/regulatory signal — determine applicability and required action.
Details have emerged about a high-severity security flaw in the Elementor Website Builder WordPress plugin that could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to create rogue administrator accounts and take control of a site. item.title: 🔴 ShinyHunters hacked Clop leak site using Grav CMS path traversal flaw
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups, endpoint protection, and recovery readiness.
The Clop ransomware gang has moved its data leak site to a new Tor address after confirming its previous server was compromised and defaced through an unpatched Grav CMS flaw that BleepingComputer has learned is an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1d

item.description:

The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warns that hackers are exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430) affecting multiple products from enterprise software provider WSO2. [...]
